name: FirstCardFileChip - Image
description: A pasted screenshot on the first card, before there is a board to put it on. The picture is the point: a pasted image has no useful filename — the clipboard supplies Screenshot and a timestamp — so the thumbnail is the only thing identifying it, and the only way to catch a mis-paste before it becomes part of the thinking. The preview comes from the real hook, in the browser, exactly as it does on the landing screen.
